title: VTA Contexts Preview-Delete — payload
description: Request payload for vta/contexts/preview-delete: what deleting this context would destroy, computed without destroying it.

id.description: Context to preview the deletion of.

Response.title: VTA Contexts Preview-Delete — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vta/contexts/preview-delete. Every array is what WOULD be affected; nothing has been. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/contexts/preview-delete/2.0#response.

subContexts.description: Sub-contexts that would be deleted along with this one, as full paths, deepest first. Deleting a context deletes its whole subtree, so every other array in this response covers the resources of these contexts as well as of the context itself — a consumer rendering the preview for a human MUST show this list, because a caller told only what the named context holds cannot see how much of the tree the deletion reaches. Absent or empty means the context is a leaf.

keys.description: Key ids that would be destroyed. A derived key can be re-derived from the seed; an internally-generated one cannot be recovered by any means, and this list does not distinguish them — a consumer rendering it for a human SHOULD resolve each key before presenting the choice.

dids.description: Every identity the deletion would delete, of every method — did:webvh and did:scid:vh:1 logs that stop being served, did:webs DIDs whose key event logs are ended, did:key identities forgotten — as vta/dids/list summarises them. Anything that recorded one as an issuer or subject is left pointing at nothing, or at a deactivated identity.

aclEntriesRemoved.description: Subjects whose ACL entry would be removed outright, because this context was its only scope.

aclEntriesUpdated.description: Subjects whose ACL entry would be narrowed — they hold other scopes and keep them.

didTemplates.description: DID templates scoped to this context that would be removed.
